track_moving_particles — PHARMA track op

• Datenarten: video → table

• Aufruf: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.track_moving_particles(frames, *, threshold=0.045, max_displacement_px=10.0, min_area_px=2, static_threshold=0.055) (die Implementierung direkt: import vialops; vialops.track_moving_particles(frames, *, threshold=0.045, max_displacement_px=10.0, min_area_px=2, static_threshold=0.055); aus dem Register: opspharma.get("track_moving_particles"))

• GPU: nein (nur CPU-Referenzimplementierung)

Verwendung

Trennt bewegte Objekte und stationäre Kratzer im Glas in einer Bildfolge und gibt eine Trajektorientabelle zurück.

> Die ausführliche Beschreibung unten ist der Originaltext — Zusammenfassung und Überschriften sind übersetzt.

Each frame is compared with the temporal median, so stationary scratches are reported from the median image and moving objects from residual components. Consecutive moving detections are linked greedily only within max_displacement_px; ambiguous or too-large jumps start a new track rather than being silently joined. Every moving track is deliberately labelled "moving": the frame-only API has neither a calibrated lighting polarity nor enough 3-D trajectory context to identify a particle versus a bubble. In particular, residual swirl can make a settling particle have a negative image-row velocity. This is a conservative 2-D projection tracker, not an identity-preserving multi-object tracker through overlap/occlusion.

動く軌跡は常に保守的に "moving" とし、速度符号だけで粒子/気泡を推定しない。残留旋回では沈降粒子も画像上向きに見えるためである。

Returns a table with one row per detection: frame, track_id, object_class, centroid, area, and row velocity. Input must be a finite non-constant (T,H,W) sequence with at least three frames. A sequence that is constant over both time and space is rejected; call it only for images with a motion or spatial cue, and record no detected motion directly when the intended interpretation is no motion.
